name: centrifugal_fan_reference_model
title: Centrifugal fan reference model (dimensionless factors)
summary: Reference simulation of a centrifugal fan transporting humid air: given the fan geometry (impeller diameter, exhaust area), the rotation speed and the supply state and mass flow rate, the model returns the flow, pressure, isentropic-effectiveness and power factors of the fan, closed on the operating point by two cubic fits in the pressure factor.

origin.course: ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory, model data bank, Distribution Systems / Fans (reference and parameter-identification models of the Laborelec toolkit lineage)

verification.reference: EES stored solution of thermo_models TM-0251 (Centrifugal_Fan_RefSim_EES_Model_ARJL080121.EES, EES 7.966, 34 of 35 variable records carry a value, run of the file's default operating point); tools/compare_solution.py, no unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J)
verification.notes: 34 common variables, 6 differ at rtol=1e-3; maximum relative deviation 1.19e-02 on c_p and C_dot, which are the moist-air specific heat and the diagnostic heat-capacity flow rate derived from it (no other equation uses them). They follow from the different moist-air models of EES and CoolProp: at 80 °C / 101325 Pa / RH 0.5 the humidity ratio is w = 0.19139 kg/kg dry air and the implied vapour specific heat is 1857.6 J/(kg K) (EES) against 1943.2 J/(kg K) (CoolProp HAASHRAE). The specific volume differs by 7.6e-04, which propagates to psi (1.36e-03), W_dot_s (1.36e-03), DELTAP_total (2.12e-03) and DELTAP_stat (2.58e-03); all the model factors and the shaft power agree within 1.4e-04 (phi 6.9e-07, V_dot 7.6e-04, C_ex 4.7e-04, lambda 8.7e-04, epsilon_s 1.0e-03, W_dot_shaft 5.2e-04). Excluded from the figure: pi, listed in the .sol as a constant, which compare_solution.py counts as 'only in CoolSolve'. coolsolve -d reports 'System square: Yes', 34 equations / 34 variables, largest block 1.
